title: Agent Profiles
description: Templates, and the agent files generated from them into a project's .claude/agents. Changes only affect new chat sessions; sessions that are already open keep what they started with.
remoteUnavailable: Agent Profiles are managed on the Host computer. This Remote tab cannot open them.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Check that the server is running and try again.
errors.PROFILE_STALE: This record was changed somewhere else (another window or device) after you opened it, so your save was refused to avoid overwriting that change. Reload the latest version and make your edit again.
errors.SLUG_TAKEN: Another record already uses this slug. Pick a different slug.
errors.DIRECTORY_NOT_FOUND: The project folder does not exist (any more). Check that the project still points at an existing folder.
errors.DIRECTORY_NOT_A_DIRECTORY: The project folder is not a folder. Check the project's path.
errors.PROFILE_CORRUPT: A stored profile file could not be read, so nothing was written. Fix or remove the file named under Templates, then try again.
errors.BLOCK_NAME_TAKEN: Another memory block already has this name. Block names are unique across all scopes (global and every project), because agents ask for a block by name alone. Pick a different name.
errors.BLOCK_LIMIT_REACHED: The limit of 50 memory blocks is reached. Delete one before creating another.
errors.BLOCK_CONTENT_LIMIT_REACHED: The limit of 200 folders for this memory block is reached. Remove a folder before adding another.
errors.BLOCK_CONTENT_EXISTS: This folder already has content for this memory block.

capabilities.noDelegationTool: This orchestrator cannot call the delegation tool (Agent), so it will not be able to hand work to other agents. Allow Agent or remove it from the denied tools.

params.empty: No parameters. Add one for each value that differs between projects (for example a git URL).
params.title: Title

keyProblem.invalid: The key must start with a letter and use only letters, digits and _ (at most 40 characters).
keyProblem.reserved: This key is filled by the project itself (project_name, project_directory). Use another key.
keyProblem.duplicate: Another parameter already uses this key.

placeholders.missing: The instructions use {{placeholder}} but no parameter has the key "{{key}}". Saving is blocked until you add it.
placeholders.unused: Parameter "{{key}}" is not used in the instructions.

template.empty: No templates yet. Create one to generate agent files from.
template.deleteConfirm: Delete template "{{name}}"? Agent files already generated from it are not changed or removed.
template.regenerateNote: Changes reach an agent file only when it is generated again (Agents > Generate agents). Open sessions are not affected.
template.name: Name
template.slugHint: Becomes the agent name and its file name (<slug>.md).
template.slugInvalid: The slug must be lower-case letters and digits separated by single hyphens (at most 40 characters).
template.slugTaken: Another template already uses this slug.
template.groupHint: Heading the agents of this template are listed under in the main-agent dropdown of a new chat. Empty = System. Takes effect at once; no need to generate again.
template.descriptionHint: The orchestrator reads this to decide when to call agents made from this template.
template.instructionsHint: Write {{example}} where the value of a parameter should go.
template.capabilitiesTitle: Tools, MCP servers, skills, model and memory
template.memoryHint: Claude Code lets an agent keep notes between sessions. When a tool list is set, Read, Write and Edit are added so the agent can reach its notes.
template.usesBlocksHint: Adds the three tools mcp__blocks__block_list, block_read and block_write to the agent's tool list (when it has one) and a short instruction on Generate: list the blocks at the start of a session, write only writable ones, never store secrets. Blocks work only in chats of this app.

memory.intro: Memory blocks are named notes your agents can read, and update when the block is writable, across sessions. Turn on "Memory blocks" in a template and generate its agents again so they use them.
memory.limits: A block applies by scope only: global (every chat) or per project, where each folder has its own content and agents see the block only in folders that have it. It cannot be limited to one agent. Blocks exist only inside chats of this app; the claude command on this computer does not see them.
memory.empty: No memory blocks yet. Create one to give your agents a shared note.
memory.deleteConfirm: Delete memory block "{{name}}"? Its content is lost.
memory.lockWarning_one: Read-only is not a hard lock: {{count}} agent in the list ({{names}}) has Bash or no tool limit, so it can still change this block's file. The list is the one loaded in the Agents tab (target: {{target}}); it is not checked per block scope.
memory.lockWarning_other: Read-only is not a hard lock: {{count}} agents in the list ({{names}}) have Bash or no tool limit, so they can still change this block's file. The list is the one loaded in the Agents tab (target: {{target}}); it is not checked per block scope.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: What agents call it: lower-case letters and digits separated by single hyphens, at most 40 characters. Unique across all scopes.
form.nameInvalid: The name must be lower-case letters and digits separated by single hyphens (at most 40 characters).

modeHint.writable: Agents can replace or append to this block.
modeHint.read-only: Only you can change this block. Agents with Bash can still change its file.

form.descriptionHint: Optional. Shown to agents in the block list (at most 500 characters).

scopeHint.global: Visible in every chat. Its text is kept in the block itself.
scopeHint.project: One definition, separate content per project folder. Agents see the block only in folders you add after saving.

form.contentTooLong: The content is longer than the limit of {{max}} characters.
form.maxCharsHint: A whole number from 1 to {{max}}. An agent write that would pass it is refused, nothing is cut. Length is counted in UTF-16 units, so an emoji counts as 2.
form.stale: This block was changed after you opened it (last writer: {{writer}}), so your save was not applied. Your edits are still in the form: save again to replace that change with yours, or Cancel to discard them.
form.staleUnknownWriter: This block was changed after you opened it, so your save was not applied. Your edits are still in the form: save again to replace that change with yours, or Cancel to discard them.
form.maxCharsInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.
form.scopeFixedHint: The scope of an existing block cannot be changed; create a new block instead.
form.projectContentHint: A project block has no text of its own. Save it, then open its Folders to add a project folder and write that folder's content.
form.maxCharsHintProject: A whole number from 1 to {{max}}. The most the content of one folder can hold; an agent write that would pass it is refused, nothing is cut. Length is counted in UTF-16 units, so an emoji counts as 2.

memory.scopeProject: Per project (each folder has its own content)

folders.title: Folders
folders.visibility: Agents see this block only in the folders listed here. A folder without content does not show the block at all, not even its name.
folders.empty: No folder has content yet. Add a folder to make this block visible there.
folders.noProjects: No project in the sidebar yet. Add one there to give its folder content.
folders.emptyConfirm: Empty the content of {{directory}}? The folder stays listed and agents there keep the block, with no text.
folders.removeConfirm: Remove folder {{directory}} from "{{name}}"? Its content is lost and agents in that folder no longer see the block.
folders.corrupt_one: {{count}} content file could not be read. The block is hidden from agents only in that folder; fix or remove the file in the agent-profiles store.
folders.corrupt_other: {{count}} content files could not be read. The block is hidden from agents only in those folders; fix or remove the files in the agent-profiles store.

generate.title: Generate agents
generate.targetProject: Agent files are written to the .claude/agents folder of project "{{name}}".
generate.targetGlobal: Agent files are written to ~/.claude/agents and apply to every project.
generate.noTemplates: No templates yet. Create one in the Templates tab.
generate.valuesHint: Filled in from what you entered for this project last time. An empty field uses the template default.
generate.valuesFailed: The values remembered for this folder could not be read. Generating without them would reset them, so Preview and Apply stay off until they load.
generate.urlUnrecognized: This does not look like a web or SSH address (https://..., ssh://..., git@host:org/repo). You can still use it.

status.duplicate: Generated before: will be regenerated from the template
status.invalid-name: The template slug is not a valid agent name, skipped
status.handmade-exists: A handmade file with this name exists, skipped. Rename or delete it to let Generate write here
status.write-failed: Could not write this file (permission or disk error, or the file is in use). The other files were still written; fix the cause and Generate again

generate.gitExcluded_one: Added {{count}} line to {{file}}, so the generated files stay out of git.
generate.gitExcluded_other: Added {{count}} lines to {{file}}, so the generated files stay out of git.
generate.gitNotExcluded: Not a git repository (or git is unavailable): nothing was added to a git exclude list.

agents.intro: The agents Claude Code offers for the chosen target: built into Claude Code, personal (~/.claude/agents) and the project's own (.claude/agents). A generated agent is a plain file rendered from a template; edit the template and generate again, not the file. Hidden agents are not offered to new sessions, in any project.
agents.noProjects: No project in the sidebar yet. Add one there to generate agents for it; the global scope is available meanwhile.
agents.fallbackNote: The built-in list could not be read from Claude Code, so a fixed list is shown.
agents.noPrompt: Claude Code does not let apps read the prompt or tools of its built-in agents.
agents.fileError: {{name}}: this agent file could not be read ({{error}}). Fix the file's front matter; the other agents are not affected.

manager.label: Profile manager
manager.hint: Lets this agent propose changes to templates and memory blocks, which you confirm under Settings, Agent Profiles, Pending. Works only for the user-level generated agent (a file in ~/.claude/agents made from a template) and only in chats on this machine, never in a Remote tab.

corrupt.title_one: {{count}} stored template file could not be read and was skipped:
corrupt.title_other: {{count}} stored template files could not be read and were skipped:
corrupt.fix: They are left untouched. Fix or remove the file in the agent-profiles folder to see it again.

scope.label: Main agent
scope.autoHint: Claude Code picks an agent for each task
scope.badgeTitle: Chosen when this chat was opened. Open a new chat to use another main agent.

step1.title: Check that Claude is signed in
step1.signedOut: Claude is not signed in yet. Chats and agents need it.

step2.title: Choose the templates to use
step2.hint: Templates are the roles your agents are made from. Tick the ones to generate agent files from in the next step.
step2.none: There are no templates yet. Create one in the Templates tab first.

step3.title: Choose a project and generate its agents
step3.hint: The agents become plain files in the project's .claude/agents folder, so Claude Code finds them in any chat on that project. Fill in the values the templates need; they are remembered for this project.
step3.noProjects: There is no project in the sidebar yet. Add the project folder in the sidebar, then run this guide again.

bundle.privacyWarning: The file contains your prompts, memory block text and folder paths. They may be private: share it only with people you trust.

export.title: Export agents and memory blocks
export.includeContent: Include block text (the text of every folder of project blocks, with its folder path)

import.title: Import agents and memory blocks
import.pastePlaceholder: Paste a bundle written by you or by an AI
import.tooLarge: This bundle is {{size}} MB, over the 5 MB limit. Split it into smaller bundles.
import.readFailed: The file could not be read.
import.sensitiveHint: Sensitive items change what an agent may do (tools, skills or MCP servers). Nothing is ticked by default: tick each one you trust.

mapping.title: Map folders to projects
mapping.hint: The bundle carries text for folders of the machine it came from. Choose the project each folder goes to. A folder left on Skip is not imported; its block still is.

import.noFolderNote: A project block without folder text arrives as a definition only: agents see it only in folders that have text. Add folders in the Memory tab.
import.nothingToImport: The bundle holds nothing to import.

result.title: Result
result.partialWarning: Some items or folders were not applied. Check the list below.
result.snapshot: A backup of what was overwritten was saved as {{name}}. You can put it back from the Restore list.

restore.title: Restore a snapshot
restore.intro: A snapshot is the backup taken before an import overwrote something. Restoring puts its items back; items created since are kept, and a fresh snapshot is taken first.
restore.empty: No snapshots yet. One is taken when an import overwrites something.
restore.confirm: Restore {{name}}? Its items replace the current ones.

codes.CONFLICT: Exists and differs. Tick Overwrite to replace it.
codes.IDENTICAL: Already the same: nothing to do.
codes.SENSITIVE_NOT_ACCEPTED: Sensitive: tick its Allow box to import it.
codes.STALE: It changed since the preview. Preview again.
codes.BASIS_REQUIRED: The preview data is missing. Preview again.
codes.BLOCK_SCOPE_IMMUTABLE: A block of this name already exists with the other scope kind (global or project). Delete or rename it first.
codes.BLOCK_NAME_AMBIGUOUS: More than one block has this name, so it cannot be overwritten.
codes.BLOCK_NOT_MIGRATED: This block was not moved to per-folder text yet, so it cannot be changed here.
codes.BLOCK_CONTENT_CORRUPT: The stored text of this block cannot be read.
codes.BLOCK_LIMIT_REACHED: The limit of memory blocks is reached.
codes.BLOCK_CONTENT_LIMIT_REACHED: The limit of folders with text for this block is reached.
codes.BLOCK_TOO_LARGE: The block text is longer than the block allows.
codes.DUPLICATE_KEY: The bundle lists this item more than once.
codes.DUPLICATE_TARGET_FOLDER: Two source folders map to the same project.
codes.no-target-folder: No project chosen for this folder: skipped.
codes.FOLDER_TEXT_HOST_ONLY: Folder text can only be imported on the host machine.
codes.DEFINITION_NOT_APPLIED: The block definition was not applied, so its folders were skipped.
codes.BLOCK_READ_ONLY: This block is read-only and cannot be written by an agent.

errors.BUNDLE_INVALID: The bundle could not be read: {{message}}
errors.BUNDLE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED: This bundle uses a format version this app does not read (it reads version 1).
errors.SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE: Snapshots are unavailable right now: the backup folder cannot be read or written.

pending.intro: Changes that manager agents proposed. Nothing is applied until you confirm it here; a proposal expires on its own after 24 hours.
pending.justNow: Proposed less than a minute ago
pending.untickedHint: Nothing is ticked by default. Items you leave unticked (overwrites, deletes, sensitive items) are skipped.
